theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) {t p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : t ≠ 0) : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) := by
  let abs_t := |t|
  have h_abs_t_pos : 0 < abs_t := by exact le_zero_iff_neg.mpr ht
  have h_exp_max : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) = Real.exp (abs_t * |x|) :=
    by rw [Real.max_exp, abs_mul, mul_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
  have h_pow_pos : 0 < (p / abs_t) ^ p :=
    by have h_p_nonneg : 0 ≤ p := hp
      have h_div_nonneg : 0 ≤ p / abs_t := by rw [Real.div_nonneg]; exact h_p_nonneg
      have h_pow_nonneg : 0 ≤ (p / abs_t) ^ p := by rw [Real.pow_nonneg]; exact h_div_nonneg
      exact lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ) (le_trans h_pow_nonneg (lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ) h_abs_t_pos))
  have h_ineq : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / abs_t) ^ p * Real.exp (abs_t * |x|) :=
    by have h_abs_x_nonneg : 0 ≤ |x| := le_rfl
      have h_pow_abs_x : |x| ^ p = Real.exp (p * log (Real.exp |x|)) :=
        by rw [Real.pow_log, Real.log_exp, Real.exp_log]
      have h_pow_p : (p / abs_t) ^ p = Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t)) :=
        by rw [Real.pow_log, Real.log_exp, Real.exp_log]
      have h_exp_abs_t_abs_x : Real.exp (abs_t * |x|) = Real.exp (log (Real.exp (abs_t * |x|))) :=
        by rw [Real.log_exp, Real.exp_log]
      have h_ineq_exp : Real.exp (p * log (Real.exp |x|)) ≤ Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t)) * Real.exp (abs_t * |x|) :=
        by have h_log_exp : log (Real.exp |x|) = |x| := by rw [Real.log_exp]
          have h_p_log : p * log (p / abs_t) = log (Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t))) :=
            by rw [Real.log_exp, Real.exp_log]
          have h_exp_abs_t_abs_x : Real.exp (abs_t * |x|) = Real.exp (log (Real.exp (abs_t * |x|))) :=
            by rw [Real.log_exp, Real.exp_log]
          have h_exp_ineq : Real.exp |x| ≤ Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t)) * Real.exp (abs_t * |x|) :=
            by rw [h_log_exp, h_p_log, h_exp_abs_t_abs_x]
            exact Real.exp_le_exp_add (le_refl (Real.exp (abs_t * |x|))) (le_refl (Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t))))
          exact Real.exp_le_exp_add (le_refl (Real.exp |x|)) (le_refl (Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t))))
      exact Real.exp_le_exp_add (le_refl (Real.exp |x|)) (le_refl (Real.exp (p * log (p / abs_t))))
  rw [h_exp_max] at h_ineq
  exact h_ineq
